orgAddress.title: Your organization has its own address
orgAddress.body: This is the address to give your stakeholders. Anyone you invite signs in and works here:
orgAddress.open: Open it in a new tab
orgAddress.brandingBody: The site at that address can carry your name, your colours and your logo instead of ours. Set it in Team → Branding; it applies to the sign-in page, the app, and the invitations you send.
